incidents.name: VDS
incidents.notes: sending VDS to its own contract redeems AVD 1:1, mismatched from the deposit ratio, letting the attacker extract AVD.

sources.ref: Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the victim sets no EIP-1967 implementation or beacon slot and its runtime is byte-identical at the creation block 52614868 and the incident block 54252254; all eight DELEGATECALL sites are solc external-library calls to the PUSH20 constant 0x1f428ffb964de7d906278382ba8902e3290f83a1 (preceded by the usual EXTCODESIZE guard), a library deployed 23 blocks before the victim by the same creator 0x6c8abda36388b15c011d9ee93a811d36df8baaaa and byte-identical over the window, so the target cannot be repointed.
